name: Ten Worlds
description: A procedural landscape countdown from chaos to calm. Each number (10→1) is an entire low-poly 3D world — neon cities, volcanic ridges, ocean archipelagos, frozen tundra — where the number's shape is hidden in the terrain itself. A mountain range silhouette that forms a "7". A river delta that traces a "3". A single hill that IS the "1". The camera flies through each world, then lifts to a bird's-eye view to reveal the hidden number, before dissolving into the next. Ten worlds. Ten seconds. Complexity melting into simplicity — arriving at one.
